correctness.rationale: PASS: Fourier separation of harmonic extension in logarithmic radial coordinate s gives uκ(s)=sinh(κ(1-s))/sinhκ, vκ(s)=sinh(κs)/sinhκ (with affine κ=0 limit). Input norm 1/2 gives exact factor2 in the 2x2 fiber Gram matrix, and the probability radial density wε,α(s) has the specified hε normalization. The ratio wε,α(s)/((α+1)s^α) is uniformly 1+Oα(ε); Loewner order controls both eigenvalues uniformly across all κ. Endpoint Laplace integrals give outer squared branch constant 2^{-α}Γ(α+2)/hε^(α+1) and inner (α+1)e^{-2ε}/hε, with exponentially negligible offdiagonal; hence separate membership powers and divergence at equality. Dominated positive Riemann sum in angular modes gives 2∫tr(Gα(κ)^{p/2})dκ after multiplying by ε. Fresh independent weighted quadrature checked 32 positivity cases, 16 eigenvalue ratio comparisons and four exact unweighted eigenpairs. No numeric check establishes the global all-κ comparison or infinite Schatten theorem; those follow from the analytic inequalities.

originality.rationale: PASS qualified: Auchmuty 2016 proves general-domain SVD for an unweighted Poisson extension via biharmonic Steklov spectrum; this is broader geometrically but does not state the asymmetric one-sided two-boundary weight, relative thin-annulus 2x2 profile or leading normalized Schatten integral. Ureyen studies weighted harmonic Bergman spaces on a real hyperbolic ball, not this two-boundary planar collar; Rozenblum studies boundary-supported Toeplitz forms with weights measured at the whole boundary, a different operator. General boundary pseudodifferential theory may imply the two individual power exponents, which are not independently exclusive novelty. The combined quantitative coefficient and global-in-mode profile remain a qualified contribution.

final_claim: For the normalized two-channel harmonic Poisson extension on a thin planar annulus with one-sided volume weight (1-|z|^2)^α, α>-1, the fixed-width Schatten threshold is p>max{2,2/(α+1)}; outer/inner squared singular branches decay as κ^{-(α+1)} and κ^{-1}, and ε||P||_S_p^p tends to an explicit positive integral of a universal 2x2 Gram profile.
